labels: Arms long, rope at face height
Pull to your face, elbows high

text.setup: Set the cable at about face height with a rope. Step back so the stack is lifted, arms straight, palms facing in.
cues: Pull the rope towards your face, splitting the ends apart.
Keep your elbows high — level with or above your hands.
Finish with your hands beside your ears and your shoulder blades squeezed, then let your arms go long.
mistakes: Pulling to your chest with the elbows low, which turns it into a row.
Leaning back to move more weight.
Going so heavy you can't hold the squeeze.

variants.resistance_band: Anchor the band at face height; it gets harder as you pull in.
